name: Uniform-Oriented-Matroid Fiber Classes
summary: Finite concept classes obtained, after suppressing fixed coordinates, as nonempty topal fibers of finite uniform oriented matroids, together with cubes.
comments: These are the cubes and the nonempty proper iterated conditionings of conditioning-minimal non-ample parents; nontrivial simple parents are exactly the connected c-minimal non-ample class. The parents themselves are non-ample and are not UOMFib members. Lawrence conjectured that every finite ample class has a UOM-fiber presentation. Equality with MaxMin is a strictly separate open factor of that conjecture.
